BillHeading.BriefDescription: Prohibiting certain contracting practices by a health carrier acting as a third-party administrator for self-insured coverage offered to public employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting certain contracting practices by a health carrier acting as a third-party administrator for self-insured coverage offered to public employees; and adding a new section to chapter 41.05 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 41.05 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) A health carrier acting as a third-party administrator for a self-funded plan offered to employees or school employees under this chapter may not require a hospital system owned or operated by the state of Washington to participate in any commercial health plan or product offered or administered by the health carrier as a condition for negotiations or participation in the self-funded plan.
(2) For purposes of this section, "health carrier" has the same meaning as in RCW 48.43.005.
